reviews.text: I’ve been traveling for the last five weeks and my dogs hair got really matted while I was away, especially w all the rain. I came back and went to get him groomed and was very forward with them when I dropped him off that I knew the situation wasn’t good. The owner called me shortly thereafter and basically told me I could either shave his whole body (a pomsky who is not meant to be shaved) or pick him up. Mind you, she was incredibly kind about it and even offered to give me other recommendations in the neighborhood. So I chose to pick him up since it’s about to be cold and it would be wrong to shave him, and know I can find other places willing to help with the situation. So I go to pick him up as they told me to and he’s still sopping wet when I arrive, and then I hear the groomer and owner get in a full blown phone call fight from the back room about him. They tell me to come back in a hour. When I picked him up, the groomer was extremely rude and judgmental and smirked at me as he handed me my dog back. Just some weird vibes here overall. If you have a very well maintained dog, this might be a great place for you. Unfortunately that was not the case w my sweet dog and since I wasn’t willing to clean shave him they weren’t willing to try to help. Truly would’ve paid whatever it just would’ve required patience that this groomer obviously didn’t possess by the vibes I was met with. I’ve heard great things about this spot-I think just make sure you have an easy to groom dog!
Love supporting local businesses. Our big loves their treats and cookies!

We have been going here forever to get our cats nails trimmed. I couldn't possibly recommend this spot more. They are affordable, very communicative, super strict on vaccine status, and everyone who works there is an earth angel who tolerates me yapping their ear off every time. 100/10. Fizz, doughnut, sweet corn & family are huge fans of bushwick bark forever.

My favorite pet store in the area. They carry most of my preferred brands and my cat’s preferred toys (:

Bonus is you get to peep cats and kittens available for adoption too.

They did an amazing job on my Collie! he looks so fresh - other dogs are checking him out. He smells amazing and his coat is shiny and beautiful, shedding is also significantly down. He is kinda nervous about grooming and this groomer made sure he was as comfortable as possible. Def go there for grooming if you are in the area.
great pet supply store!! super cute adoptable cats there too! the store really cares about pets!
Best pet supply store in Brooklyn.

I used their self service dog wash service. Employees were very friendly and helpful. They provide towels, shampoo, conditioner, brush, a dryer and an apron to (help) keep you dry. There’s a bench and a leash that attached to the wall to use. Definitely will use again.

Had no idea what time this place closed (was a couple minutes late) dog was excited to go in. But started walking away and whoever the girl was who ran to the door (in a walking boot no less) came to give my dog a treat.

Super nice and unexpected.
